criterion 1.description: Includes a distinct Ground Floor finding for Ground western D3 at the Entrance Hall / Living Room side intersected by Section B-B, identified as G-01 or by an equivalent unambiguous location-specific identifier.
criterion 1.justification: On Ground_Floor_Plan.pdf, the Section B-B cut line passes through the western D3 door opening on the Entrance Hall / Living Room side, while Section_B_B.pdf draws a continuous cut Interior Wall at that position in the Ground floor band. This is finding G-01; an equivalent identifier is accepted where the physical occurrence is unmistakable. A finding referring only to the eastern D3 on the Dining side does not satisfy this separate western D3 requirement.

criterion 2.description: Classifies the finding at Ground western D3 at the Entrance Hall / Living Room side intersected by Section B-B as Mismatch.
criterion 2.justification: On Ground_Floor_Plan.pdf, the Section B-B cut line passes through the western D3 door opening on the Entrance Hall / Living Room side, while Section_B_B.pdf draws a continuous cut Interior Wall at that position in the Ground floor band. The expected classification is Mismatch: the drawings show a definite contradiction, which Drawing_Coordination_Review_Standard.pptx page 2 classifies as Mismatch.

criterion 3.description: Explains the Ground Floor western D3 issue at the Entrance Hall / Living Room side where Section B-B crosses the Ground Floor Plan: the plan shows a door opening intersected by the cut line, but the Ground band of Section B-B shows a continuous cut interior wall at the corresponding position.
criterion 3.justification: On Ground_Floor_Plan.pdf, the Section B-B cut line passes through the western D3 door opening on the Entrance Hall / Living Room side, while Section_B_B.pdf draws a continuous cut Interior Wall at that position in the Ground floor band. Graded on naming the compared drawings, the location and the nature of the contradiction or uncertainty, not on any proposed correction.

criterion 4.description: Includes original drawing crops for the Ground Floor western D3 at the Entrance Hall / Living Room side intersected by Section B-B: the Ground Floor Plan showing this D3 and the B-B cut, and Section B-B showing the corresponding continuous wall in the Ground band.
criterion 4.justification: Drawing_Coordination_Review_Standard.pptx page 4 requires crops from the relevant drawings showing both sides of the disputed relationship with enough grid or level context to verify it. For G-01 the relevant drawings are Ground_Floor_Plan.pdf and Section_B_B.pdf. Judged from the content visible in the crop image, not from its caption.
